name: Phone home screen: apps get deleted
description: A black phone on the clean background shows a home screen (status bar, a big clock, a grid of rounded app tiles with labels). The apps marked for removal start to jiggle, get an orange minus badge and pop away one after another, leaving dashed empty slots; a white card beside the phone counts them down to 0, and one kept app can end on an orange ring.
use_when: Deleting or not having apps: a digital detox, 'no social media on my phone', 'I removed every distracting app', 'my phone only has these tools', cleaning up a home screen.

apps.help: home-screen apps in grid order (4 per row): [{label, icon, remove, star}]; label <= 10 characters, generic names only ('Reels', 'Feed', 'Chat'), never a brand; icon is a GFX icon name; remove: true pops it away; star: true rings the kept app at the end

time.help: big clock on the home screen, e.g. '11:30'

label.help: small label on the counter card; '' hides the card

note.help: short line under the count, e.g. 'on my phone'

date.help: small line under the clock, e.g. 'Focus mode' or 'Monday, 12 June'; '' hides it
